title: CS2 — Cross-Currency Pricing
description: FX-adjusted price gaps between non-USD listings and their nearest-in-time USD baseline (dbt mart_cross_currency_dislocation, ASOF-joined), synced from DuckDB via analytics/export_to_grafana.py.

list.name: app_id
list.label: Game (app_id)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT app_id FROM dim_item ORDER BY 1

list.name: iso_code
list.label: Currency
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT iso_code FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT iso_code) AS n FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at)
SELECT avg(abs(pct_gap)) AS avg_abs_pct_gap FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at)
SELECT coalesce(max(abs(pct_gap)), 0) AS max_abs_pct_gap FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at)
SELECT max(synced_at) AS last_sync FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation

panels.title: FX gap vs. USD baseline, over time
panels.description: Each point is one non-USD observation's % gap against the nearest-prior USD observation of the same item (ASOF join — see dbt/models/marts/mart_cross_currency_dislocation.sql). Near zero and centered around it, at this sample size, is the honest finding per README — not a bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time, pct_gap, market_hash_name || ' (' || iso_code || ')' AS metric FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1
SELECT iso_code, avg(pct_gap) AS avg_pct_gap FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT observed_at, market_hash_name, iso_code, local_price_major_units, rate_to_usd, usd_equivalent, usd_baseline_price, pct_gap FROM mart_cross_currency_dislocation WHERE app_id = $app_id AND iso_code IN ($iso_code) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 200
